MCU Friday AMBIENT WATCH LOOP triggers (config/watcher_mcu.json).

This file is deliberately SEPARATE from config/watcher.json (the V8 watcher's
file): the two registries differ (e.g. MCU has no files.find_recent_doc or
digestcheck.verify_attribution), so sharing a config made one watcher abort on
the other's triggers. Edit THIS file to opt in for the MCU daemon
(.venv/bin/python -m friday_mcu.watcher --once or --poll 30).

Each trigger:
  id        - unique name (appears in var/logs/mcu_tasks.jsonl as mcu-watch:<id>)
  goal      - natural-language goal, planned through L4 (LLM) and cached per daemon run
  plan      - INLINE deterministic plan dict (no LLM) - preferred for unattended triggers
  schedule  - {"type": "time", "at": "HH:MM", "days": ["mon"...]} fires once per day;
              {"type": "file", "directory": ..., "name": <substring>} fires once per
              new matching file (seen state persists across restarts); special types:
              whatsapp-media, telegram-media, telegram-text, discord-text
  enabled   - false = inert; set true to activate
  notify    - desktop notification on completion (default true)
  allow     - optional primitive allowlist (exact names or 'mod.*' patterns); any plan
              step not on the list is REFUSED before execution. Keep the allowlist
              tight for unattended triggers - see config/watcher.json for precedent.

Credentials come from config/credentials.json (gitignored) or env vars; see
friday_mcu/env.py for the mapping.

ALL TRIGGERS BELOW ARE INERT (enabled: false) until you flip them on.
